name: pagespeed_check
description: Run Google PageSpeed Insights on a public URL.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Public page URL, e.g. https://example.com/ or example.com

arguments.name: strategy
arguments.desc: Device to test. Google indexes mobile-first, so mobile is the default.

name: cwv_trend
description: Show how a site's real-user Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) changed over the last ~40 weeks, from the Chrome UX Report History API.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Public URL or domain, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing/

name: ai_crawler_check
description: Check whether AI and search crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, CCBot and more) can reach a page: robots.txt rules per bot, noindex/X-Robots-Tag directives, a user-agent probe for firewall/CDN blocks, sitemap and llms.txt presence, which bots publish IP ranges for allowlisting, and AI usage preferences (Cloudflare Content-Signal, IETF Content-Usage, TDMRep, noai).

name: schema_check
description: Check a page's JSON-LD structured data against Google's rich-result requirements for common types (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Review, Event, VideoObject, Service, JobPosting and more).

name: security_headers
description: Grade a site's security headers with Mozilla HTTP Observatory and list exactly which headers are missing or weak (HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), plus HTTPS and cookie flags.

name: gsc_query_classifier
description: Classify a Google Search Console queries export to find AI-assistant traffic: conversational prompts, follow-up pivots, AI-visibility tracker probes, agent prompts, pasted strings and chat reply artefacts, with impressions per bucket.

arguments.name: csv_text
arguments.desc: The contents of Queries.csv from a Search Console export

name: entity_check
description: Check how a brand appears in Wikidata, the open knowledge base that Google's Knowledge Graph and AI assistants draw brand facts from.

arguments.name: brand_name
arguments.desc: Brand name, used if no Wikidata item lists the website

name: ai_render_check
description: Show what AI crawlers that don't run JavaScript (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot) actually see on a page: readable words in the raw HTML, title, meta description, H1 and headings, JSON-LD, images without alt text, and whether the page is a JavaScript app shell that looks empty to them.

name: agent_readiness
description: Check how ready a site is for AI agents: llms.txt (validated against the llmstxt.org format, with broken-link check) and llms-full.txt, Markdown versions of pages, agent and API discovery files (MCP, A2A agent card, RFC 9727 API catalog, OpenAPI), RSS/Atom feeds, sitemap size and freshness, and Organization/WebSite schema.

name: wikipedia_presence
description: Find Wikipedia articles (in the 10 largest language editions) that link to a domain, and the brand's own Wikipedia article page views over the last 12 months (found through Wikidata).

name: authority_check
description: Compare up to 10 domains (a site and its competitors) by Tranco popularity rank (top 1M sites).

name: data_connections
description: Explain how to connect the user's own Google Search Console, GA4 and Bing Webmaster Tools data to AlchemyAgent.
